about.content.description: Column of the sources table of the about page: how many pages or documents the site kept from the repository.

about.contribute.description: Link of the about page to the contribution address of the configuration.

about.correct.description: Lead of the paragraph of the about page saying how a page is corrected.

about.correctText.defaultMessage: Every page carries at its foot the path of its file and a link to the forge. There is no other way to edit, and that is deliberate.
about.correctText.description: Paragraph of the about page saying how a page is corrected.

about.lastChange.description: Column of the sources table of the about page: the newest change of the repository.

about.lead.defaultMessage: This site is rebuilt at every change of the repositories. It is not edited here: every correction is made in the original file, and appears at the next publication.
about.lead.description: Sentence under the title of the about page.

about.nature.description: Column of the sources table of the about page: what the repository holds.

about.notContained.defaultMessage: What the site does not contain.
about.notContained.description: Lead of the paragraph of the about page listing what was left out.

about.notContainedText.defaultMessage: The files the configuration excludes, the documents whose conversion failed, and the words used fewer than {count, plural, one {# time} other {# times}}. The
about.notContainedText.description: Paragraph of the about page listing what was left out, before the link to the report; the count is the publication threshold of a keyword page.

about.pages.description: Figure at the head of the about page: how many pages the site holds.

about.pseudonymised.description: Lead of the paragraph of the about page on pseudonymisation, shown when the configuration enables it.

about.pseudonymisedText.defaultMessage: The names of the participants are replaced at publication by stable pseudonyms. The mapping is never published.
about.pseudonymisedText.description: Paragraph of the about page on pseudonymisation.

about.publishedAt.description: Figure at the head of the about page: the build instant.

about.publishedOn.description: Label of the first figure of the about page, the build instant.

about.report.description: Link of the about page to the to-do page, which lists what the build could not finish.

about.reportLists.description: End of the paragraph of the about page listing what was left out, after the link to the report.

about.repository.description: Column of the sources table of the about page: the name of the source.

about.sources.description: Heading of the sources table of the about page.

about.sourcesLead.defaultMessage: each with the version exactly used
about.sourcesLead.description: Sentence next to the heading of the sources table of the about page.

about.staleExceeds.defaultMessage: exceeds the freshness threshold of {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}, which is reported here and in the build report, never on the pages themselves.
about.staleExceeds.description: End of the sentence naming a dormant source under the sources table of the about page, after its name.

about.staleSource.description: Start of the sentence naming a dormant source under the sources table of the about page, before its name.

about.title.description: Title of the about page, and its link in the footer.

about.version.description: Column of the sources table of the about page: the commit the build read.

about.versionsNote.defaultMessage: The versions are those read at publication: two publications on the same versions produce an identical site.
about.versionsNote.description: Note under the sources table of the about page.

about.words.description: Figure at the head of the about page: how many words the index lists.
